note_tweet.text:
We haven't given up on Grok Bot, but we have started offloading workflows to Meta Muse and other cloud hosted agents. Muse is the primary platform we are experimenting with due to the high amounts of free usage. 

We found that Meta Muse's UI isn't as native as grok bot for Multi agent coordination and overall business workflows, which is why we built an iMessage application layer over Muse. Giving it a grok-bot-style user experience. (Group chats, multi-agent coordination etc..)

We have been testing Claude Duet in preview but have found the product to perform worse than Muse for GrokBot style tasks. I anticipate this will change as Duet leaves preview.

note_tweet.text:
We ran into the same issue: Running out of Grok Bot usage far too quickly.

So we built AgentMsgr, an app to coordinate agents cross-platform. Make a group chat that has your Grok Bot & Meta Muse in it (or any agent!)

You can coordinate cross-platform agents to work together, or you can have them off load tasks when usage is getting low.

We have been enjoying this tool internally, but are searching for users to demo our product and give us feedback.

Try free https://t.co/xwQeBgCauG

Hi, I build: Remote support shouldn't cost more than the problem you're fixing. 🖥️⚡
Meet Carpathron Remote, our remote desktop app for Windows and Linux, now with a built-in AI technician.
Why people switch:
✅ Free for personal use. Sessions up to 20 minutes, up to 2 hours a day, no ads.
✅ The PC you're helping never needs a licence. Your parents, a client or a colleague just install it free from the Microsoft Store.
✅ Pro from €19.99 a year per PC, controlling up to 3 PCs (€3/month). Max is €49.99 a year for unlimited PCs. Entry plans of the big remote-desktop brands typically run about $25–29 a month.
✅ Windows and Linux, all on one relay.
🤖 The AI technician: your own AI, your own key
Connect your own key from Anthropic (Claude), Meta (Muse) or OpenAI, and the technician works inside the remote session:
🔍 It diagnoses the problem from what it sees on the remote PC
🛠️ It proposes and runs the fix, and if a command fails, it reads the error and tries again
💬 It explains every step in plain language while it works
🔐 The person at the other PC approves admin actions, so nothing happens behind their back
There's no AI subscription from us and no mark-up on tokens: you pay your AI provider directly, often a few cents per fix. You can also switch between AI services mid-job.
🛡️ Built with security first:
• Full control is only allowed after the person at the PC approves on screen
• Automatic lockout after repeated wrong passwords
• Updates are cryptographically signed, so only genuine Qubitpage updates install
